evals.name: python-key-rotation-format
evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 format 程序（Python），让 aproxy 在三个 key（sk-a、sk-b、sk-c）之间轮换请求的 Authorization 头，再给出 config.toml 里对应的配置。程序存为输出目录的 rotate.py，配置片段和说明写到 answer.md。
evals.expected_output: rotate.py: persistent-mode loop reading stdin line by line, UTF-8 safe on Windows, exits on EOF, writes exactly one compact JSON line per request with headers present, flushes, logs only to stderr, rotates authorization (ideally offset by worker_id); config: request_transform with mode = "persistent", command/args pointing at python and the script.

evals.name: debug-bash-format-502
evals.prompt:
我的 aproxy 实例所有请求都 502，返回体里有「format 输出违反信封协议」。我的 format 是这个 bash 脚本：

```bash
#!/bin/bash
while read -r line; do
  echo "processing request"
  echo "$line" | jq '.headers.authorization = "Bearer sk-x"'
done
```

帮我找出原因并修好，修好的脚本存为输出目录的 fixed.sh，原因写到 answer.md。
evals.expected_output: Two causes: the 'processing request' echo goes to stdout (must go to stderr), and jq pretty-prints multi-line JSON (needs -c). fixed.sh uses >&2 for the log line and jq -c, keeps one line per request; the while-read loop already exits on EOF.

evals.name: official-binary-anthropic-to-openai
evals.prompt: 用官方 aproxy-format，把 Claude Code（Anthropic 协议）发来的请求转到一个 OpenAI 兼容的端点 https://llm.example.com/v1/chat/completions，key 是 sk-test，模型 claude-sonnet 映射成 gpt-4.1。把聚合配置文件和 aproxy 的 config.toml 片段写到输出目录，并在 answer.md 里说明有什么限制。
evals.expected_output: Aggregation TOML with explicit client_format = "anthropic_messages", a channel with format openai_chat, the full endpoint URL, the key, and the model mapping; config.toml with request_transform and response_transform both pointing at aproxy-format run in persistent mode with extra = the aggregation file. States that cross-protocol conversion is non-streaming only, so Claude Code's streaming requests will not convert.
